prompt: Create one full-body collectible toy character for a friendly children's 3D factory game. Static calm walking stance, modest staggered feet, BOTH shoe soles flat on exactly the same ground plane. Exactly two arms and two legs. Holds a thick small clipboard with blank cream face vertically against one forearm; the other arm hangs naturally. Distinct broad shoulders but friendly proportions.
